title: EBP sections 8 and 10 - Camera mappings (CML1)

container.notes: EBP section 8 or 10 (camera mappings; magic 'CML1', u32 entryCount, 8 unknown bytes, 16-byte rows from 0x10 (u32 labelOffset, u32 link, 8 unknown bytes), then a pool of NUL-terminated Shift-JIS labels, zero padding to 16; labelOffset is counted from the section start). EBP = *.ebp, 0x80-byte header: magic 'EBP2' at 0x00, twenty u32 section offsets at 0x10-0x5F counted from the EBP start (0 = absent; this section = u32 at EBP+0x30 (section 8) / EBP+0x38 (section 10)), 0x04-0x0F and 0x60-0x7F not interpreted. Sections start on 16-byte boundaries with zero fill; a section spans to the next larger non-zero offset (the highest to end of file), so the span includes padding. Section 6 is a TIM2 texture and section 19 an embedded ARD (FF12AR03); a rebuild must carry both. Little-endian throughout.

records.name: cml1Header
records.where: Offset 0 of EBP section 8 (u32 at EBP+0x30) or section 10 (u32 at EBP+0x38).

fields.name: entryCount
fields.notes: Number of 16-byte mapping rows starting at 0x10.

fields.name: unknown08
fields.notes: Not interpreted (zeros from the Workshop). Preserve.

fields.name: labelOffset
fields.notes: Offset (from the section start) of this row's label: a NUL-terminated Shift-JIS string in the pool after the row table. Must be rewritten when the pool is rebuilt.

fields.name: link
fields.notes: Number the label maps to. Probably an index into the camera list (section 9 for section 8); unverified.

fields.name: unknown08
fields.notes: Not interpreted (zeros from the Workshop). Preserve.

roundTrip: Keep the magic 'CML1' and header bytes 0x08-0x0F as read.
Editing link (or the 8 trailing bytes) in place needs no other change.

A changed label is safest done by rebuilding the pool: write all labels (Shift-JIS, one 0x00 terminator each, no alignment between them) right after the row table, rewrite every labelOffset, zero-pad the section to 16.
A label whose Shift-JIS bytes are not longer than the old one can also be overwritten in place (terminate with 0x00, fill the rest of the old string with 0x00).
Keep row order; if the vanilla rows turn out to be sorted by label, keep them sorted when adding rows.
Adding/removing rows moves the pool: rebuild it and all labelOffsets; update entryCount.

If the section length changes, every EBP section stored after it moves: recompute their u32 slots at EBP+0x10+4n, keep 16-byte starts with zero fill, keep absent sections at 0, keep section 6 (TIM2) and section 19 (ARD) intact.
gaps: What link indexes. Likely section 8 maps camera names to section 9 camera blocks.

What section 10 maps: the runtime keeps camera mappings, cameras, camera-shake mappings, camera shakes and models in that order (Toolkit), which suggests section 10 = camera-shake mappings and section 11 = camera shakes. Unverified.
Meaning of header bytes 0x08-0x0F and of row bytes 0x08-0x0F.
Whether vanilla pools are in row order, deduplicated, or sorted, and whether the game looks labels up by binary search.
